name: Japanese Horror Game Protagonist
summary: Japanese Horror Game Protagonist is a fashion aesthetic and TikTok microtrend that emerged in 2023, which consists of outfits inspired by the female protagonists in popular Japanese horror games, most notably the Fatal Frame series.
description: Japanese Horror Game Protagonist is a fashion aesthetic and TikTok microtrend that emerged in 2023, which consists of outfits inspired by the female protagonists in popular Japanese horror games, most notably the Fatal Frame series. The aesthetic is related to and largely reliant on Coquette fashion, specifically the Dark Nymphet subtype, with added 2000s-era Japanese influences. It is characterized by dark-colored, hyper-feminine pieces, layered with accessories to evoke the appearance of heroines from Japanese horror media.
